name: PRAGMA
ontology_notes: Eval of a lifelong personalized assistant, not a memory engine and not a character. 100 synthetic users from Privasis-Zero, 400 queries (100 each of Event-Align, Event-Correct, Traj-Align, Traj-Correct), about 160K tokens per user history, 4,167 sessions (HF card. 3,000 filler, 494 event, 673 trajectory). Metrics are session-level evidence Recall / Exact Recall and GPT-5 alignment plus grounding on open-ended guidance. User modeled is an assistant user with evolving events and two latent behavioral axes. Covers hole 2 as corrective queries and hole 10 as year-scale timestamped histories only in the assistant sense. Misses holes 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Not character identity, lore vs lived, or RP silence.

supersession.evidence: Trajectory queries track 4-8 timestamped states on two axes. Corrective queries require rejecting a current assumption that conflicts with that trajectory. That is evolution and conflict with prior state, not a user forget-that or a dated overwrite API. Yu et al. arXiv 2609.09664 §3.1 Table 2.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Events span 2025-05-01 to 2026-04-30. Sessions are timestamp-ordered. Filler sessions sit between evidence, and first and last sessions are always filler. HF card. 40-42 sessions per user in the preview table.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: One user profile talking to one assistant. No character, relationship, or lore types.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Corrective queries require not following a mistaken user premise. Alignment on Event-Correct stays between 2 and 8 for practical systems under gpt-5-mini (Table 3). That is sycophancy / wrong-assumption handling, not trauma, kink, or spoiler silence on a known fact.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No stored jailbreak of system persona. Failures are missed evidence, weak grounding, and over-accommodation to the user.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: No forget-that items. Trajectory change is still in the history. It is not a deletion.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: 160K tokens is a difficulty knob (Table 1). Reported scores are alignment and grounding, not cost-per-turn.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Dataset LICENSE on Hugging Face is NVIDIA License with a non-commercial use limit (research and evaluation only, NVIDIA itself may use commercially). GitHub construction code has no LICENSE file (gh api license null). Judge is GPT-5.
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Would prefer systems that recover distributed evidence and then give guidance aligned with an evolving user trajectory, including correcting a wrong premise. Still a personalized assistant. Would not select for character identity, RP silence, or poisoning.

published_eval.name: PRAGMA
published_eval.claimed_score: Table 3 gpt-5-mini. A-MEM Traj-Align alignment 81, grounding 16. Event-Correct alignment 2 to 8 across practical systems. Full-context Traj-Align grounding 8. Table 4. Oracle-Summary Traj-Align alignment 99 / grounding 86 vs Oracle-Session 78 / 17. Table 5. Query rewriting Traj-Align Recall 95.95 and Exact Recall 80 but alignment 25 / grounding 20. Table 7. A-MEM preserves 99.1% of Traj-Correct evidence and retrieves 48.9%.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Open-ended personalized guidance (recommend, plan, decide) over lifelong assistant chat. Alignment with user experience or trajectory, and explicit grounding in annotated evidence sessions. Four types. Event vs trajectory, aligned vs corrective. Not pointwise fact QA and not character identity.

open_unknowns: GitHub construction repo has no LICENSE. Dataset is NVIDIA License (non-commercial). Code license is therefore unknown.
Not the Revolut banking PRAGMA paper 2604.08649. This card is 2609.09664 only.
